messages:
marie (sec-eng): Quick sync — quarterly admin entitlement prune. We need to run the access review next week. Can owners confirm who'll own the RBAC sweep + audit-log checks? cc @oliver @raj

oliver (people-ops): People Ops will own notifications and the roster. I can draft the email and calendar invites. Tue 09:00 PT work for everyone?

tom (infra): I can run the membership/key listings and share outputs. Will post the exact commands shortly.

marie (sec-eng): Thanks. Plan is to identify stale admin roles, ownerless service accounts, and any KMS key use anomalies before removals. Need rollback plan too.

 tom (infra): ```# IAM / RBAC queries (examples)
# AWS CLI (list policies attached to users/groups with "Admin" in name)
aws iam list-entities-for-policy --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

-- RBAC DB example (Postgres)
SELECT user_id, role, last_seen_at
FROM rbac.user_roles
WHERE role ILIKE '%admin%'
  AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < now() - interval '90 days');

# service account keys older than 90 days (pseudocode)
SELECT sa_id, key_id, created_at
FROM service_accounts.keys
WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days' AND rotated = false;
```

sasha (devex): Please include a step to check owner tags on service accounts. Last month we found a build SA with no owner and active keys. I can help triage ownerless ones.

raj (sec-ops): For audit logging / KMS: check CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt and aws:kms in last 30 days, then correlate with principal. CloudWatch Logs Insights snippet:

```fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId
| filter eventSource = 'kms.amazonaws.com' and eventName in ['Decrypt','GenerateDataKey']
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```

raj (sec-ops): Also verify CMK key rotation status and that no cross-account grants persist. I'll run those checks and flag any unexpected principals.

marie (sec-eng): Proposed runbook (high level):
1) People Ops notifications + owner confirmations (oliver)
2) infra list & export of admin roles and keys (tom)
3) devex triage ownerless SAs + tag updates (sasha)
4) sec-ops audit KMS/CW/CT logs and produce anomaly list (raj)
5) platform/devs review proposed removals + 24h rollback window + ticket template (lee)
6) final approval meeting Wed 10:00 PT to apply removals

lee (platform): Add a rollback ticket template with exact grants to recreate (role, scope, justification) and a 24h support window. I can provide the template.

oliver (people-ops): I'll send invites and the initial notification today. Draft message will include deadline for owners to respond (48h). :thumbsup:

marie (sec-eng): audit-bot note: last entitlement sweep ran 2025-12-11 — 42 admin accounts changed (auto-archived).

raj (sec-ops): I'll publish a short checklist in #eng-security-checklists after I finish the KMS queries.

tom (infra): posting the exported CSV here after I run the scripts. Expecting to include columns: user, role, last_active, owner, key_count.

marie (sec-eng): Perfect. No objections heard — proceeding with the plan. If anyone needs different times, speak now. Otherwise we'll regroup on Wednesday. Thanks all.

audit-bot: Reminder scheduled: entitlement-sweep/quarterly at 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z (auto-notify sent).
